title: Deal Acceleration 1:1 - capture + action items
content:
Purpose: quick sync to unblock renewal negotiation and confirm engineering commitment for a custom integration. High level ask is to move contract signature within 3 weeks and secure a PO. Tone: collaborative but firm — surface risks, propose mitigations, leave with concrete owners and dates.

Meeting agenda (20min):
- 00:00 quick status (2m) — where the decision-maker landed after last exec demo
- 02:00 main blockers (5m) — legal T&Cs, SSO integration timeline, perf guardrails
- 07:00 ask list + escalation path (6m) — what we need from AE/SE/Eng to close in 3 weeks
- 13:00 contingency options (4m) — temporary trial terms, limited feature scoping, payment milestones
- 17:00 confirm owners & deadlines (3m)

Key facts to call out:
- ACV target: $540k ARR (12-month commitment). Renewal target: 2026-04-01 signature target date.
- Current technical blocker: SSO + SCIM provisioning requires ~3 dev days and access to customer's IdP test tenant.
- Performance ask from customer: sustained 75 RPS with p95 < 200ms on our Dedicated offering — they've requested benchmark data for a similar profile.
- Procurement timeline: customer procurement requires PO within 14 calendar days after signed SOW to hit Q2 budget cycle.

Open questions I want resolved in the meeting:
- Can SE commit to a prioritized 3-day eng slot within next 10 business days? (if not, what's earliest?)
- Legal: can we accept their proposed liability cap with carveouts for data breach? If not, what counter?
- Pricing: are we able to offer 10% discount for a 12-month prepay if they sign by 2026-03-22?

Talking points / scripts:
- Exec sponsor message: "We built the Dedicated flow specifically for customers with predictable throughput needs — our team will partner on a short integration plan so you get to production without falling back to an expensive pilot."
- For procurement: "We can ship an interim SOW that scopes only SSO + performance validation to hit your PO deadline, then follow with a phase 2 SOW for full rollout."

Risk signals (ranked):
- High: Procurement stalls after SOW due to PO window closing (impact: miss quarter).
- Medium: Eng availability delays SSO integration (impact: customer stalls testing).
- Low: Unexpected legal redlines that require C-Suite escalation (impact: 1-2 week delay).

Mitigations to propose live:
- Offer a short-term limited-production pilot (30 days, capped tokens) to validate perf while legal and procurement finish paperwork.
- SE to provide a "runbook" checklist for the customer's IdP so test tenant setup is done in parallel with SOW.
- If procurement needs more time, accept a refundable deposit to hold pricing and seats for 30 days.

Action items (owner — due):
- AE (Liam) — confirm stakeholder list and get procurement deadline in writing from customer (due 2026-03-12).
- SE (Marcus) — confirm eng slot availability and estimate for SSO work (due 2026-03-13).
- Customer Success (me) — draft interim SOW focused on SSO + perf validation and circulate to AE/Legal (draft by 2026-03-11).
- Legal (Aisha) — quick read on customer's liability cap and recommended counter (due 2026-03-14).
- Product (optional) — provide recent benchmark summary for p95 latency on Dedicated with similar model profile (requested by 2026-03-12).

If any of above misses deadlines: escalation path
- Missed AE date -> escalate to head of sales (Tina) to push procurement.
- Missed SE slot -> request temporary contractor allocation via release-engineering (cc: EngOps).
- Legal stall -> set up 30-min huddle with GC to prioritize this contract.

Notes from last conversation with customer (raw):
- "We're excited to move but tight on security signoffs; our infosec wants KMS integration and audit logs."
- They asked for a sandbox with data-masking; unclear whether we can support within current timeline.
- Customer champion is willing to push procurement but needs a clear list of deliverables to share with finance.

Email template to send after meeting (short):
- Subject: Next steps from today — SSO SOW + procurement timeline
- Body: Thanks for the sync. Summary of agreed owners/dates: [AE confirms stakeholder + deadline], [SE confirms slot], [CS drafts interim SOW]. Attached: interim SOW draft, runbook checklist link. Please confirm by EOD 2026-03-12 or we will proceed with the contingency of refundable deposit.

Back-pocket ask if we need to escalate: 15% accelerated discount for a prepay contract (we only use if procurement demands stronger incentive).

Scratch / things to follow-up after meeting:
- Collect IdP metadata from customer and create a shared test tenant — add to GH ticket.
- Pull audit log examples and KMS integration docs for customer infosec review.
- Create a short demo video (2-3min) showing Dedicated dashboard and per-route latency breakdown — good asset for exec-level reassurance.

Personal notes to self:
- Keep the meeting focused; avoid getting stuck on minor T&C language — hand to legal after alignment on timeline.
- Have numbers visible in the doc during call (ACV, timelines, seats) — helps move procurement.
- After meeting, send the email within 2 hours to keep momentum.
